instruction: Automatically enhance the audio quality of this video to reduce background noise based on the current environment.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VLC cannot automatically detect and adapt to environmental noise levels. It requires manual audio filter configuration and cannot analyze the current room's acoustic environment.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly identified as infeasible - VLC cannot automatically detect environmental noise and adapt audio enhancement
